title: Rethinking Software Development as a Self-Adaptive Socio-Technical System
abstract: arXiv:2609.13461v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic AI is expanding across various software engineering activities, yet human-agent organization is typically treated as fixed, which is problematic because development configurations may become suboptimal as development context evolves. We propose viewing software development as a self-adaptive socio-technical system in which both the software project and the development configuration (participants, responsibilities, authority, information, and verification) adapt as goals, evidence, uncertainty, and risk evolve. This yields two coupled forms of adaptation: evolving the software and reconfiguring how subsequent engineering is performed. We illustrate the idea with a proof of concept, outlining challenges and future plans.

translated_title: 重新思考软件开发：将其视为自适应的社会技术系统
translated_abstract: 智能体AI（Agentic AI）正在扩展到各种软件工程活动中，然而人-智能体的组织方式通常被视为固定的，这是有问题的，因为随着开发环境的演变，开发配置可能变得不再理想。我们提出将软件开发视为一个自适应的社会技术系统，其中软件项目和开发配置（包括参与者、职责、权限、信息和验证）都会随着目标、证据、不确定性和风险的演变而进行自适应调整。这产生了两种相互耦合的自适应形式：软件本身的演进，以及后续工程执行方式的重构。我们通过一个概念验证来阐述这一想法，并概述了相关挑战和未来计划。
tldr: 提出将软件开发视为自适应的社会技术系统，使软件项目和开发配置（人员、职责、权限、信息和验证）能够随目标、证据、不确定性和风险的演变而共同自适应调整。
